name: Mirror Spirit
description: Hold up a mirror of feeling so that a foe's menace shows to them first.

name: Facing Glass
description: Face a spirit across the mirror and read what it hides in its reflection.

name: Glass Calm
description: Hold a mirror to a troubled ally until they see their own calm returning.

name: Reflected Dread
description: Throw a foe's own dread back from the mirror until they cannot tell it from fresh menace.

name: Second Mirror
description: Set a second mirror behind the first so that hostile feeling is bounced back twice.

name: Mirror Step
description: Step through the gap between the mirrors so that the foe's gaze loses the user.

name: Infinite Mirrors
description: Face the mirrors together so that a foe sees endless copies of their own fear.

name: Looking Back
description: Throw a hostile spirit's full intent back through the pair at the one who sent it.

name: Unavoidable Reflection
description: Set the two mirrors face to face about a foe until they must see themselves and their will sinks.

name: Heart Pair
description: Hold the user's heart and an ally's heart as a pair so that neither stands alone.

name: Answering Beat
description: Feel the answering beat of a second heart to learn how near it is.

name: Matched Breath
description: Match the breath of a fearful ally and slow it until their spirit follows.

name: Pulse Mirror
description: Echo a foe's racing pulse back at them so that their rhythm breaks.

name: Linked Courage
description: Link the courage of two hearts so that each grows bolder from the other.

name: Halved Burden
description: Take half of an ally's heavy lingering feeling onto the user's own heart and let it pass.

name: Wavering Pair
description: Set two foes' hearts to answer each other wrongly so that they misread one another.

name: Heart Lock
description: Lock a foe's heart to the user's pace so that every step they take is shared.

name: Two-Hearted Rally
description: Rally a whole company by the sound of paired hearts and mend their shaken spirits.

name: Heartsworn
description: Bind the hearts of a company to one beat that lifts allies and slows every foe near.

name: Far Sky Spirit
description: Lift the spirit high above the field and read the many minds beneath.

name: Weak Heart Find
description: Find the weakest heart in a body of foes by the thinness of its feeling.

name: High Calm
description: Hold a cold high calm that hostile feeling cannot climb to.

name: Kestrel Weight
description: Drop the whole weight of the spirit on one found weak heart.

name: Blue Reassurance
description: Spread a wide blue reassurance over allies that eases their fear of the field.

name: Aloof Step
description: Withdraw to a place of cold calm in the middle of a charge.

name: Piercing Look
description: Pierce the guard of a foe's spirit with a single look aimed at its weakest feeling.

name: Harm Warning
description: Keep a long vigil over the field and warn allies of every rising feeling of harm.

name: Apex Heart
description: Rise to the height of feeling and press the field below it into stillness.

name: Feeling Cup
description: Hollow a basin in the spirit so that hostile feeling pours in and pools harmlessly.

name: Pooled Mood
description: Read the pooled mood of a crowd to learn what it is about to do.

name: Silt Settle
description: Let the clouded feelings of a shaken ally settle until the spirit is clear.

name: Brimming Gauge
description: Gauge how full the basin has grown and how near it is to overflow.

name: Quiet Drain
description: Drain hostile feeling out of the field slowly into the basin without notice.

name: Mood Torrent
description: Send the stored mood out along a river of feeling that carries foes with it.

name: Overflow Gift
description: Pour a measure of stored courage over the allies nearest the basin.

name: Flood Feeling
description: Loose the stored feeling in a flood that swamps the will of a group of foes.

name: Scouring Current
description: Run the basin through a clean channel and wash dread out of every ally within reach.

name: Crowd Reservoir
description: Draw the whole feeling of a great gathering into the basin and send it out as one force.

name: Open Ear
description: Open the spirit's ear to every nearby soul and take in all that it hears.

name: True Answer
description: Answer the feeling that is meant and let the feeling that is false pass by.

name: Gale Quiet
description: Keep the oath of listening in the middle of a loud and angry crowd.

name: Hidden Name
description: Hear the feeling beneath a name and learn what the speaker truly means by it.

name: Sworn Soothing
description: Soothe an angry spirit by showing it that it has been truly heard.

name: Lie Tear
description: Tear the feeling away from a lie so that it falls flat in the foe's mouth.

name: Heard Whole
description: Hear every spirit in a company and give each the sense of being fully understood.

name: Truth Gale
description: Send a gale of felt truth through the foe so that every false thought is stripped bare.

name: Unbound Hearing
description: Hear through distance and walls and slip the user's own presence to wherever a spirit calls.

name: Spirit Spread
description: Spread the spirit out as a level plain so that nothing can approach unseen.

name: Far Dust
description: See the dust of an approaching feeling long before the spirit itself arrives.

name: Feeling Step
description: Move away from the line of an approaching feeling while it is still far off.

name: Evening Calm
description: Settle an ally's spirit with the quiet of a long evening on the open plain.

name: Gathering Sense
description: Sense a hostile feeling while it is still gathering and warn allies by a touch.

name: Sprawling Calm
description: Spread the calm so wide that sudden fear finds nothing to catch on.

name: Long Sight Gift
description: Give an ally a share of the plain's long sight so that they see danger early.

name: Level Weight
description: Lay the broad weight of the plain on a foe's will until it sags.

name: Encircling Spirit
description: Hold a ring of watching spirit round the company so that no feeling of harm slips in.

name: Open Dominion
description: Make the whole field one open plain of feeling where every foe is read and held still.

name: Mood Sail
description: Raise a sail of attention to catch the moods that the wind carries in.

name: Wind Courier
description: Send a short feeling of reassurance on the wind to an ally far off.

name: Drift Guard
description: Let a hostile mood drift past on the wind and not settle in the spirit.

name: Answer Carried
description: Receive an answering feeling from a distant spirit and learn how it stands.

name: Sent Unease
description: Send a thin unease on the wind to a hidden foe and shake their aim.

name: Mood Rinse
description: Rinse stale dread from an ally on a clean current of air.

name: Wind Link
description: Link the spirits of distant allies on the wind so that all feel one another's state.

name: Gust Dread
description: Drive a gust of dread across a foe's ranks so that their courage gives way.

name: Carried Sovereign
description: Ride the moods of the wind across great distance and arrive in the spirit of a far ally.

name: Bearing Spirit
description: Take a sworn bearing toward every spirit met and refuse to be turned from it.

name: Heading Check
description: Check the user's own feeling against the sworn bearing and see how far it has strayed.

name: Turned Aside
description: Keep the bearing as a spirit tries to sway the user with a borrowed feeling.

name: Return Course
description: Bring a spirit knocked off its bearing back to its true course.

name: Lie Detect
description: Hold the bearing and feel at once when a spirit speaks against its own feeling.

name: Counter Sway
description: Cancel an attempt to sway a spirit with one firm sworn word.

name: Fixed Mood
description: Fix a foe's mood where it stands so that it can neither rise nor fall.

name: Company Bearing
description: Share the sworn bearing with a company so that no foe can sway them.

name: Spirit Sovereign
description: Hold the full bearing and cancel every borrowed feeling in the field while reading each source.
